race.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Selling Stakes
race.verdict: PUROSANGUE was a good second at Wolverhampton on Tuesday and looks favoured by the terms of this race. He makes most appeal ahead of Moving Force and Bassenthwaite . PUROSANGUE MOVING FORCE (IRE) BASSENTHWAITE
